latestVersion.changelog:
SecretCodex v1.0.0 – Launch Release

- Generate creative project and agent code names with customizable tone and themes.
- Encode and decode messages using classic ciphers: Caesar, ROT13, Atbash, Pigpen, Polybius Square, Vigenère, and Rail Fence.
- Supports key-based encryption for secure communication between trusted parties.
- Blend nostalgia (decoder rings, visual ciphers) with modern, layered cryptography concepts.
- Ideal for learning crypto basics, private messaging, games, and puzzles.
